release_transition._doc: OWNER-APPROVED PROVENANCE TRANSITION (ITEM 408 Items 6-7, Option A; owner Luke McAlister via execution supervisor GPT Sol 5.6, 2026-07-23). The authorised Round 15-19 recovery is genuine production Movers history. These reports were generated under the earlier accepted PRESENT-LENS release (`source`); the application has since advanced to the current accepted release (`destination`). This record is the SEPARATELY-DECLARED, owner-approved bridge that lets the UI display the historical reports under the current release WITHOUT pretending they were generated under it, and WITHOUT rewriting any report. The browser validator (ui/app/movers.js core) requires this record — matching the historical reports EXACTLY on `source` and the loaded application EXACTLY on `destination`, with the reports' content digest intact — before it will display a historical bundle whose identity differs from the loaded release. Absent / partial / wrong / reversed / tampered => fail closed. It authorises NO score application (gate OFF), NO rewrite of history, and NO ledger / per-round-movers movement. The store and board DO move across this ITEM 411 D1 transition — the declared restructure edit pass, attributed row-by-row in the ITEM 411 change manifest — which is why this record is RESTATED to describe the new transition rather than reused unchanged; the superseded 408-era invariants are preserved as history under `invariants.superseded_408_era`.
release_transition._schema_version_note: BUMPED 1 -> 2 by ITEM 411 D1 (Amendment 5). The ITEM 411 D1 restatement changed the TYPE of `owner_ruling_id` from a single string to a list of strings; a consumer written against v1 would read a list where it expected a str. That type change must not ship under an unbumped version, so the version is advanced with it. No field was removed and no other type changed. Consumer-safety was re-verified at the bump: nothing in the tree validates or branches on `release_transition.schema_version` (ui/app/movers.js reads kind / owner_approved / source / destination / applies_to only); every other schema_version assertion in the tree is on the UNRELATED `weekly_movers_report` / `matchday_movers_bundle` schemas.
release_transition.owner_ruling: The authorised Round 15-19 recovery counts as genuine production Movers history. Retain the R15-R19 production Movers reports; do not reset the production Movers bundle to empty; preserve the historical reports and implement a fail-closed provenance bridge to the current accepted release identity. No historical report may be silently rewritten.

release_transition_register._doc: OUT-OF-ROUND DOB COURIER LANDING + v0surf RE-CUT (#334, 2026-08-10). The 302 staged birthdates land in the store (the #290 runbook's section-5 courier act, which was specified and never fired), and the frozen V0 pick-curve surface is re-cut on the owner's authorisation because the real birth data changes its config signature. Appended, not substituted: every prior entry is preserved verbatim. THE BOARD MOVES, but barely: 6 of 804 players move by exactly +/-1 SCAR (William McCabe, Mitchell Marsh, Maxwell King, Luke Urquhart and Isaac Cumming +1; Jevan Phillipou -1), board total 761583 -> 761587, backward board 0 movers, PICK 1 numeraire unmoved at 3000. The mechanism: _v0surf_sig hashes every historical national draftee's DRAFT AGE, which reads _by; with no birthdate the engine assumed draft age 18, and 14 of the 302 are mature-age draftees inside picks 1-64 whose real draft ages are 19-22, so they move across the surface fit's 18/19 split. No model, curve law, dial or config value changed: rl_model, engine_head, fv, config and register are all byte-unchanged across this transition.

release_transition_register._doc: OUT-OF-ROUND NEVER-RISES RESTORE (#334 rulings 1.1 + 1.2, 2026-08-10). The owner's V0 law (ledger R12: a year-zero value curve never rises as the pick number rises) was lost by omission at the #306 anchored-lens landing on 2026-08-05 and is restored here: within each (position x draft age) profile the composed lens curve is projected to non-increasing over the log-pick grid by isotonic regression — the deleted _iso_dec step's exact behaviour — after the lens multiply and after the neutrality fixed point. The frozen V0 pick-curve surface is re-cut through the declared refit lane because the projection changes it. Appended, not substituted: every prior entry is preserved verbatim. THE BOARD MOVES, and small: 439 rising steps inside picks 1-64 fall to 0 across all 90 position x draft-age profiles (2779 -> 0 over the full 1-90 grid); 82 of 804 players' year-zero value moves (47 down, 35 up — the merge), 16 displayed board prices move (9 down, 7 up; largest cut -18 Xavier Taylor, largest rise +24 Daniel Annable), board total 761587 -> 761574 (-13, -0.0017%), PICK 1 numeraire unmoved at 3000. The store is UNCHANGED: no store write, no model level, no dial, no teaching. rl_model, fv, config and register are byte-unchanged across this transition; engine_head moves because the restored step and the D14 gate wiring live in it.
release_transition_register.owner_ruling: Issue #334, comment 5235660463, 2026-08-10, the owner's eleven decisions as filed. Ruling 1.1 RESTORE — YES, his words verbatim: "Yes, restore... Realistically, each position should have a 1-64 curve I would have thought. Their own ones." — with the disposition recorded in the same comment that the restore is the old law's exact method, the isotonic merge within each position x draft-age profile, and that "Every moved player [is] enumerated". Ruling 1.2 GATES — YES: "The gate suite wired into the standing gated-build path (every board build runs it, halts on failure) plus a new surface-level scan (all cells x picks, not just rostered players)." Ruling 1.3 (the ledger move) is HELD and nothing in this transition touches the ledger.
